title: Psychology says people use subtitles even when fluent to hear and see words
description: In contemporary viewing habits, subtitles have emerged as a favored choice for audiences, transcending language barriers. They serve to enhance understanding and facilitate information retention during video consumption. Studies show varying engagement levels with subtitles, shaped by individual language skills and exposure. Furthermore, the dual experience of auditory and visual dialogue enriches the viewing experience, indicating that subtitle preference doesn't equate to a struggle with audio comprehension.

description: In a significant ruling, an Ohio court has reinforced an 1843 land-use regulation aimed at maintaining a public square integral to community life. Originally donated to Parkman Township by Simon and Nancy Perkins, this 2.63-acre area faced legal challenges from developers, but the court ultimately sided with the township, emphasizing their duty to uphold the community's interests. This decision underscores the importance of preserving historical public spaces.

title: China, Russia’s reality check for Trump: Why US sanctions may not matter any more

title: 20 bids push Noosa beachfront flat from A$5.3m in 2014 to record A$21.5m

This property has seen a dramatic appreciation from A$5.3 million in 2014, indicating a robust real estate market and captivating attention from 80 spectators and 8 bidders, igniting excitement among potential investors and long-term clients.

title: Amritpal Singh gets 3-hr custodial parole to attend grandmother’s cremation on Nov 21
description: Khadoor Sahib MP Amritpal Singh was granted a three-hour custodial parole on November 21 for his grandmother's cremation. After the court initially allowed an earlier parole, delays in travel arrangements led to rescheduling. Singh will travel from Dibrugarh jail to his native village under police escort. The court will also facilitate his virtual attendance at other ceremonies following the cremation.

title: Texas dad raising child in Thailand wins new hearing after court voids divorce

Kevin Painter, Sr. had spent six years abroad with their child while his ex-wife had returned to the United States.

title: 'Fans proved me wrong': Dhoni's latest post after IPL retirement goes viral

The groundbreaking ceremony took place on November 15, marking the project's official commencement. The Mata Sri Mandiram Charitable Society is leading the initiative to create a memorial for her legacy. Alongside the memorial, additional temples and social service facilities will also be developed.

After conceding a penalty equaliser, India responded with three second-half goals to move closer to qualifying for the 2027 tournament.

This initiative allows staff to leave with substantial financial and career guidance, enhancing their professional journey. Open until December, the offer specifically addresses those who feel their careers have plateaued, as Microsoft adapts its team structure for emerging opportunities.

Despite suggestions for more traditional vehicles, Kalam remained committed to his choice of transportation. He expressed his inspiration from Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath's governance model and its symbolism.

title: British Airways told to pay Rs 1.05 lakh for denying boarding to US green card holder
description: In a notable consumer rights verdict, a commission in Telangana found British Airways deficient in service to Dr Kattar Divaker Rao, a US green card holder who was wrongly denied boarding despite having confirmation. The airline's claim regarding the necessity of a UK transit visa was challenged by the commission. Consequently, British Airways must compensate him with Rs 1 lakh and comply within 45 days.

title: After asking employees to use AI, why PwC now wants 85,000 of them to not trust AI
description: PwC is rolling out a critical thinking and judgment certification for more than 85,000 partners and employees across its US, Mexico and Acceleration Center offices. Starting December, the six-month programme will train staff to evaluate AI outputs, challenge assumptions and make informed decisions, using diagnostics, simulations and a personalised AI coach. PwC US chief people officer Yolanda Seals-Coffield said employees’ skills will be assessed during year-end performance reviews.

title: Ed Kelce's sacrifices shaped Jason and Travis Kelce's NFL careers
description: Ed Kelce supported Jason and Travis from their childhood sporting days to their NFL careers. He coached them, helped manage their busy schedules and made sacrifices alongside Donna. Even when his marriage faced difficulties, he continued putting his sons first. His support remained strong after their success, including when the brothers faced each other in Super Bowl LVII.
